---
title: "scRNA Trajectory and Gene Programs"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

## Purpose

Fit trajectory-aware gene programs and store pseudotime summaries in a Seurat object.

## Packages

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-06-trajectory-gene-programs-packages
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load only the packages used in this template.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(qs2)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

## User Config

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-06-trajectory-gene-programs-user-config
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# USER INPUT:
input_object <- "path/to/seurat_clustered.qs"
output_object <- "path/to/seurat_trajectory_programs.qs"
results_dir <- "results/trajectory_gene_programs"
figures_dir <- "figures/trajectory_gene_programs"
assay_name <- "RNA"
reduction_name <- "umap"
sample_column <- "sample_column"
group_column <- "group_column"
pseudotime_column <- "pseudotime"
features_of_interest <- c("GENE1", "GENE2")
n_bins <- 20
seed <- 1
n_threads <- 4
compress_level <- 6
```

## Input Loading

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-06-trajectory-gene-programs-input-loading
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Create output folders and load configured inputs.
set.seed(seed)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
object <- qs2::qs_read(file = input_object, nthreads = n_threads)
DefaultAssay(object) <- assay_name
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-06-trajectory-gene-programs-validation
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Stop early when required inputs or columns are missing.
stopifnot(inherits(object, "Seurat"))
stopifnot(all(c(sample_column, group_column, pseudotime_column) %in% colnames(object[[]])))
stopifnot(reduction_name %in% names(object@reductions))
features_of_interest <- intersect(features_of_interest, rownames(object))
```

## Input Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-06-trajectory-gene-programs-input-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Write a small TSV summary of the loaded input.
input_summary <- object[[]] |> tibble::as_tibble() |> summarise(cells = n(), pseudotime_min = min(.data[[pseudotime_column]], na.rm = TRUE), pseudotime_max = max(.data[[pseudotime_column]], na.rm = TRUE))
readr::write_tsv(input_summary, file.path(results_dir, "trajectory_input_summary.tsv"))
input_summary
```

## Main Analysis

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-06-trajectory-gene-programs-main-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Run the reusable analysis step for this template.
expr <- FetchData(object, vars = c(features_of_interest, pseudotime_column, group_column))
expr$pseudotime_bin <- cut(expr[[pseudotime_column]], breaks = n_bins, include.lowest = TRUE)
program_tbl <- expr |>
  group_by(pseudotime_bin, .data[[group_column]]) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(features_of_interest), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

## QC Checks

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-06-trajectory-gene-programs-qc-checks
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export checks that make failures easy to inspect.
bin_counts <- expr |> count(pseudotime_bin, .data[[group_column]], name = "n_cells")
readr::write_tsv(bin_counts, file.path(results_dir, "pseudotime_bin_counts.tsv"))
```

## Visualization

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-06-trajectory-gene-programs-visualization
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save compact figures for the main outputs.
pdf(file.path(figures_dir, "trajectory_features.pdf"), width = 7, height = 5)
if (length(features_of_interest) > 0) print(FeaturePlot(object, features = features_of_interest, reduction = reduction_name))
dev.off()
```

## Object Result Storage

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-06-trajectory-gene-programs-object-result-storage
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Store reusable analysis metadata inside the object.
object@misc$trajectory_gene_programs <- list(features = features_of_interest, pseudotime_column = pseudotime_column, n_bins = n_bins)
```

## Result Export

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-06-trajectory-gene-programs-result-export
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export the main reusable tables as TSV files.
readr::write_tsv(program_tbl, file.path(results_dir, "trajectory_gene_programs.tsv"))
```

## Final Save

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-06-trajectory-gene-programs-final-save
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save the updated object for the next template step.
qs2::qs_save(object, file = output_object, nthreads = n_threads, compress_level = compress_level)
```

## Output Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-06-trajectory-gene-programs-output-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Print a compact summary of generated outputs.
tibble::tibble(output_object = output_object, features_used = length(features_of_interest))
```
